hypothesis.repeatedWork: Fresh ordinary matching clears new int storage to zero, fills the entire predecessor array with minus-one, then overwrites every active predecessor. Reused ALPH storage still gets a complete minus-one pass before forward writes. Only skipped prefixes of very long uniform runs require minus-one without a forward hash write.
hypothesis.intendedDesign: Build the ordinary owner initially empty and let its existing Fill-specific ResetStorage acquire overwrite capacity before allocation. Initialize each forward-read predecessor exactly once: actual link or bounded minus-one skipped-run span. Remove global sentinel fill. Keep the ordinary owner lifetime/root/capacity unchanged, and preserve BuildBox zero-initialization semantics without a new general zeroing policy/cache/pool.
ownershipAudit: Ordinary Build creates the owner then calls Fill before any successful return; cancellation/refusal dispose it.
ALPH creates an empty owner and Fill resets it between non-overlapping filters. Surviving prepared candidates do not retain this match index.
ResetStorage is called only by Fill, so overwrite allocation is local to the complete ordinary initializer.
BuildBox writes only accepted matches and relies on untouched zeros. Its constructor stays zero-initialized; applying uninitialized allocation globally would be incorrect.
readBeforeWriteProof: For count<=2 Fill clears all returned words before successful return.
Forward hashing processes a prefix monotonically; each ordinary/repeated position writes its predecessor before that entry can become a head.
A long-run skipped prefix is the only forward hole. Initialize that precise interval to minus-one before advancing, with bounded cancellation checks.
The penultimate entry is explicitly assigned. Final entry is never a predecessor/query and is cleared at completion.
Reverse queries/chain entries point strictly backward. Right-to-left outputs overwrite only entries after their last predecessor read; terminal endpoints are explicitly zeroed.
No partially initialized index may escape a failed Build. Reused internal scratch stays borrowed and cannot overlap a surviving prepared candidate.
hypothesis.scope: Existing complete transparent RGBA8 Q75/effort4 and opaque VP8L Q75/effort4 first, preserving exact packets. Source-derived write removal is not timing, allocation reduction, physical-peak measurement or a predicted CPU gain.
hypothesis.costs: No new owner/buffer or retained storage. Same charged int capacity. Runtime overwrite allocation is permitted to return zeroed storage; do not infer skipped physical zeroing or CPU gains. Removing the full sentinel pass should be assessed on complete operations before broader qualification.
